claims.content: Customer navigates to the 'My Account' page and selects the option to list new items for auction.
System presents a form for entering item details (e.g., title, description, category, starting bid).
Customer fills out the form with required information about their personal jewelry item.
Customer uploads photos of the jewelry item.
Customer reviews the entered information and submits the listing request.
System validates the submission and confirms the item has been successfully listed for auction.

If the system detects that the uploaded photos do not meet the specified requirements (e.g., file size, format, or content guidelines as defined in the 'Product Image' section of the admin application), the system rejects the upload and prompts the customer to re-upload compliant images.

If the system validation in step 6 fails because required fields are missing or contain invalid data (e.g., starting bid is not a valid number, category is not selected), the system highlights the errors and returns the customer to the form to correct them.

If the customer attempts to list an item but has not completed their profile information (specifically shipping and billing addresses as required in the 'My Account' section), the system interrupts the listing process and redirects the customer to complete their profile before proceeding.

If the customer's account is locked due to non-payment of previous auction fees or violation of terms of service, the system prevents the listing action and displays a message instructing the customer to contact support or resolve the outstanding issues.
